results.title: Sources ordered by failing article count with tie-break

steps.title: Given a completed analysis with at least 3 verified sources
When the Actions Center is opened on the ALL tab
Then the list is titled Target Sources
And sources are ranked descending by failing article count
And ties are broken by badge count then citations

results.notes: Rank1 frandroid.com 26 articles. Tie 2/3: kbb.com(10,2 badges)>automobile-propre.com(10,1 badge). Tie 4/5: elpais.com(9,13x)>zonebourse.com(9,5x).

results.title: Source type filter available and defaults to all

steps.title: Given a completed analysis with sources of multiple types
When the source type filter is inspected
Then the filter defaults to All source types
And the dropdown lists only types present in scope

results.notes: Filter: Tous les types de sources. Dropdown: Academique(1),Agregateurs(12),Entreprise(26),Gouvernement/ONG(4),Journalisme(101),Autre(9),Sites d avis(10),Reseaux sociaux/UGC(3).

results.title: Card view and list view switchable same order

steps.title: Given the Target Sources list is displayed in card view
When the user clicks the List view toggle
Then the list view shows the same sources in the same ranked order
And no re-sorting control is available

results.notes: List view: table #,Source,Type,Action,Articles,Citee. Same order 1=frandroid(26),2=kbb(10),3=automobile-propre(10). Column headers not sortable.

results.title: Card shows all required fields

steps.title: Given the Target Sources list renders in card view
When a source card is inspected
Then the card displays the rank number
And the source name is displayed with its icon
And the source type is shown
And the applicable reason badges are shown
And the failing article count is displayed
And the citation count is displayed

results.notes: frandroid.com: rank 1, favicon Google s2/favicons(naturalWidth=24), Journalisme, 2 badges(AMELIORER LA VISIBILITE+AMELIORER LA PERCEPTION), 26 articles, Citee 43 fois.

results.title: Badges come only from persisted verdicts

steps.title: Given a source has brand-absent and brand-negative failing articles
When the source card is displayed on ALL tab
Then the card carries both IMPROVE VISIBILITY and IMPROVE PERCEPTION badges
And badges are derived from page-level verdicts only

results.notes: PARTIAL - frandroid.com shows both badges. 24 brand-absent+2 negative from GEO-1116. Cannot confirm page-level vs answer-level via UI.

results.title: Three verdict tabs ALL selected by default

steps.title: Given a completed analysis with verified sources
When the Actions Center is opened
Then three tabs are visible ALL IMPROVE VISIBILITY IMPROVE PERCEPTION
And ALL is selected by default

results.notes: Tabs: TOUTES[selected], AMELIORER LA VISIBILITE, AMELIORER LA PERCEPTION. TOUTES has [selected] attribute on initial load.

results.title: ALL tab shows total failing article count

steps.title: Given a source has both VISIBILITE and PERCEPTION failing articles
When the ALL tab is active
Then the failing article count is the total across both verdicts

results.notes: frandroid.com: ALL=26=24(VISIBILITE)+2(PERCEPTION). kbb.com: ALL=10=5+5. Total=sum of verdict-specific counts confirmed.

results.title: Verdict tab ranks on that verdict alone

steps.title: Given sources with different VISIBILITE and PERCEPTION failing article counts
When the IMPROVE VISIBILITY tab is selected
Then each source shows only its VISIBILITE failing article count
And sources are ordered by VISIBILITE count descending

results.notes: VISIBILITE tab: automobile-propre.com=10(rank 2) vs kbb.com=5(rank 7). ALL tab: kbb(10)=rank 2>automobile-propre(10)=rank 3. Re-ranking by verdict-specific count confirmed.

results.title: Source absent from verdict tab if no matching article

steps.title: Given source A has only VISIBILITE articles and source B has only PERCEPTION articles
When the IMPROVE PERCEPTION tab is selected
Then source A does not appear in the IMPROVE PERCEPTION tab
And source B appears in the IMPROVE PERCEPTION tab

results.notes: automobile-propre.com(VISIBILITE-only) ABSENT from PERCEPTION tab. kbb.com(both badges) in PERCEPTION tab rank 1 with 5 articles.

results.title: Badges unchanged when switching verdict tabs

steps.title: Given a source carries both badges on the ALL tab
When the user switches to the IMPROVE VISIBILITY tab
Then the source still shows both badges unchanged

results.notes: frandroid.com on VISIBILITE tab: rawText includes both AMELIORER LA VISIBILITE and AMELIORER LA PERCEPTION. Badge display independent of active tab filter.

results.title: Empty verdict tab message other tabs reachable

steps.title: Given no source has negative-mention failing article so IMPROVE PERCEPTION tab is empty
When the IMPROVE PERCEPTION tab is selected
Then the tab states that no source carries that verdict

results.notes: SKIP - Given condition not met. Current analysis has PERCEPTION sources: kbb.com(5),trustpilot.com(5),caradisiac.com(3),frandroid.com(2),electrek.co(2). Different dataset required.

results.title: Domain logo shown neutral placeholder when unavailable

steps.title: Given a source with resolvable favicon and one without are both in the list
When the Target Sources list renders in card view
Then the source with resolvable favicon shows its domain logo
And the source without resolvable favicon shows a neutral placeholder icon

results.notes: PARTIAL - All cards use Google s2/favicons. First 10 sources naturalWidth=24(real favicons). autopista.es naturalWidth=16(Google generic placeholder). Cannot confirm app own neutral placeholder.

results.title: Top 10 shown with explicit control for remainder

steps.title: Given a completed analysis with more than 10 verified sources
When the Target Sources list renders
Then only the top 10 sources are initially visible
And a Show N more sources control is displayed below the list
When the user activates the Show N more sources control
Then the remaining sources become visible

results.notes: Initial render: exactly 10 cards + Afficher 157 sources de plus button. After click: 167 total, show-more button gone. 10+157=167 confirmed.

results.title: Filter dropdown shows count per source type

steps.title: Given the Target Sources list is open with multiple source types present
When the source type filter dropdown is opened
Then each source type entry displays the type name and its source count

results.notes: Dropdown: Academique(1),Agregateurs(12),Entreprise(26),Journalisme(101),Autre(9),Sites d avis(10),Reseaux sociaux/UGC(3). Format Type(N) confirmed.
